title: Accessibility & Update Clarity (v3.2.2)
summary: Accessibility options expanded and update messaging became clearer, so the app is easier to use and easier to trust.
improvements: Added an in-app What's New dialog
bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Added reduced motion support
- Improved contrast for readability
- Added color-vision support options

## Improvements

- Added an in-app What's New dialog
- Made update messaging clearer

## Why this matters

Accessibility & Update Clarity (v3.2.2) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Added reduced motion support gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved contrast for readability gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added color-vision support options gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added an in-app What's New dialog gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
